subject: System Design
title: Scalability Defined
description: Learn Scalability Defined in one minute.

hook.text: Your app works perfectly for 100 users. At 10,000 users, pages take 30 seconds to load.

buildup.text: Scalability is a system's ability to handle growing load without degrading performance.

discovery.text: A scalable system maintains response times and reliability as users, data, or traffic increase.

twist.text: Scalability isn't just about traffic. Data growth, team size, and feature complexity all need to scale too.

climax.text: Scalability is not a feature you add later — it's a property you design for from the start.

quiz.question: What does scalability mean?
options: Handling growing load without degrading performance
